description: Caller tokens retain out-of-order empty sources through two identity stages. Restored observations read original Z rather than synthetic T (engine §§1, 7, 12).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage letters
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item X | Y | Z %emits $
%stage triples
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item X | Y | Z %emits $
%stage main
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text X Y a | X Y b | X Y c
%rule a [+T] Z %conditions $.source-text = "", Z ⊆ $.first-token.tags
%rule b [+T] [+T] Z
%rule c T Z
```
